answer_1.quote: Grammatical error correction (GEC) is the task of adjusting a text's spelling, grammar, and linguistic style to conform to an approved language standard or convention.

answer_2.quote: Here we employ a language agnostic metric for scoring our models, the GLEU score. ... we also report ERRANT scores using a language-agnostic approach, disregarding error types and only reporting the span-based F 0.5 scores for each test set.
